anomalies.observed: D30 pin 4 (A2, the anode of the second LED die) and R60 pin 2 are both on ESTOP_OUT. R60 pin 1 goes to D30 pin 2 (K2). The series path from ESTOP_OUT through R60 and LED2 therefore starts and ends on the same net, so the LED2 branch has no voltage across it and cannot conduct. The first LED die has its cathode resistor R59 returned to GND.
anomalies.expected: The cathode-side resistor of the second LED should return to GND, mirroring R59 on K1. As wired, the LED2 branch is shorted to its own node.
anomalies.impact: The second status LED on the dual indicator never lights, and the ESTOP_OUT net carries an extra load through a loop that does nothing useful.

anomalies.observed: R36 is valued "24k", but its library description and MPN (FRC0805J240TSD) describe a 24Ω part, so the value is inconsistent with the selected component.
anomalies.expected: A 24Ω resistor as described by the part's own metadata, not 24kΩ.

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "R36") (value "24k") ... (description " 125mW Thick Film Resistors 150V ±100ppm/℃ ±5% 24Ω 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS")

anomalies.impact: If the 24kΩ value is fitted, the bank-balancing or bleed path across the supercap bank is about 1000 times weaker than intended.

anomalies.observed: The anodes of D4, D14 and D23 are the only pins on net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW. No driver, supply, switch or other component is connected to that net, so these LED anodes have no supply.
anomalies.expected: A switched 3.3V source (the net name implies a switch or power driver) should drive these anodes, as the other indicator anodes are driven from /LED_3.3V_POWER_NONINV or +3V3.
anomalies.impact: The Ethernet activity LEDs D4, D14 and D23 cannot light, so the link/activity indication is lost.

parsed.summary: The netlist shows an apparent wiring error on the dual status LED D30, where R60 returns to ESTOP_OUT, the same net as the LED anode, so that LED branch is shorted. Two lower-confidence findings are an R36 value that conflicts with its 24Ω part metadata and LED anodes on a net that nothing drives.
